kaikki_vikisozluk.e: عَنْعَنَ • (ʕanʕana) Iq (non-past يُعَنْعِنُ (yuʕanʕinu), verbal noun عَنْعَنَة (ʕanʕana))
g: to narrate (a ḥadīth) using the preposition عَنْ (ʕan, “on the authority of”)
to pronounce the ء (ʔ) like ع (ʕ), in such manner as to pronounce عَنْ (ʕan) instead of أَنْ (ʔan), which is said to have been characteristic of the Tamīm (تَمِيم) tribe
